claim_boundary: This registry records what the frozen local artifacts establish; it does not replace public-study protocol review.
Missing instrument, polarity, chromatography, medication, assignment, or pairing metadata remain missing and are never imputed.
A contrast row is not an independent replication unit when it shares participants, cultures, source family, or parent project with another row.
